:::{#thm-gamma-moments}
#### Moments of the gamma distribution

If $T \sim \dGamf{\shape, \rate}$, then for every [integer](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/number-systems.html#def-integers) $k \ge 0$:

$$\E{T^k} = \frac{\gammafn(\shape + k)}{\gammafn(\shape) \, \rate^k}$$

:::

::: proof

$$
\ba
\E{T^k}
&= \int_0^\infty t^k \, \frac{\rate^{\shape}}{\gammafn(\shape)} \, t^{\shape - 1} \ef{-\rate t} \, dt
&& (\text{definition of expectation, with the gamma density}) \\
&= \frac{\rate^{\shape}}{\gammafn(\shape)} \int_0^\infty t^{\shape + k - 1} \ef{-\rate t} \, dt
&& (t^k \cdot t^{\shape - 1} = t^{\shape + k - 1}) \\
&= \frac{\rate^{\shape}}{\gammafn(\shape)} \cdot \frac{1}{\rate^{\shape + k}} \int_0^\infty u^{\shape + k - 1} \ef{-u} \, du
&& (\text{substitute } u = \rate t) \\
&= \frac{\rate^{\shape}}{\gammafn(\shape)} \cdot \frac{\gammafn(\shape + k)}{\rate^{\shape + k}}
&& (\text{definition of the gamma function}) \\
&= \frac{\gammafn(\shape + k)}{\gammafn(\shape) \, \rate^k}
&& (\rate^{\shape} / \rate^{\shape + k} = \rate^{-k})
\ea
$$

:::
